title.value: Assessing Intrapartum Risk of Hypoxic Ischemic Encephalopathy Using Fetal Heart Rate with Long Short-Term Memory Networks
title.justification: The title of the paper clearly states the subject of the study, which is the assessment of intrapartum risk of hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) using fetal heart rate with LSTM networks.
title.quote: Assessing Intrapartum Risk of Hypoxic Ischemic Encephalopathy Using Fetal Heart Rate with Long Short-Term Memory Networks

extractions.description: This paper investigates the prediction of the risk of hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) using fetal heart rate (FHR) data and long short-term memory (LSTM) networks. The study focuses on using cardiotocography (CTG) records to predict HIE risk in newborns during labor. The paper discusses the method of data preprocessing, classification experiments, and the performance of the predictive model.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on using deep learning for medical predictions, specifically hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy in newborns. There is no emphasis on climate or ecological sustainable development in the goals or applications discussed in the paper.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: This study investigated the prediction of the risk of hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy using intrapartum cardiotocography records with a long short-term memory recurrent neural network.
